_doc: Feature flags for code (see docs/cd.md). public=false: the feature is live in production but only signed-in EmDash editors and admins see it; visitors don't. public=true: everyone sees it (that is the release). A Worker var FLAG_<NAME>=true|false overrides at runtime for everyone (false = kill switch, also for editors). Never store content or secrets here. Remove a flag once its feature is fully released.

page_composer.description: Editors compose pages: Apertura (hero) block, button lists and style presets (background, spacing, width, columns) on every section. Until released, visitors see the old layout and no Apertura blocks.

design_refresh.description: Redesign with the client deck's look: dark brand bands, eyebrow labels, the animated G network, redesigned cards, steps, CTA, header and footer, scroll reveals and page transitions. Needs page_composer on (release page_composer first). Until released, visitors see the current design.

cookie_notice.description: Garante cookie and privacy compliance: the cookie notice (bottom card, shown again after 6 months), and the footer's legal row with company data, P.IVA, privacy and cookie policy links and 'Preferenze cookie'. Release only after the Privacy policy (/privacy/) and Cookie policy (/cookie/) pages are completed and published in EmDash. See docs/legal/garante-compliance.md.
